## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the situation where you hit this limitation - the real workflow matters more than the proposed feature. (e.g. "When I reverse engineer a 200-table schema, I can't ...")

## Proposed solution

How you imagine it working in Schemity.

## Alternatives you considered

Other ways you tried to solve it (in Schemity or with other tools).

## Anything else?

Mockups, examples from other tools, or links that help explain the idea.
